map.供应商月度考评：把某供应商当月交货批次拆成「总批次、准时批次、合格批次、准时且合: Supplier monthly appraisal: split a supplier's monthly delivery batches into four count types — total, on-time, qualified, on-time-and-qualified — and compute on-time rate, good-rate, and joint pass rate in one click as the basis for performance scoring.
map.到货质量复盘：当准时但不良、或未准时但合格的批次较多时，联合合格率会明显低于单项: Arrival quality review: when there are many on-time-but-defective or not-on-time-but-qualified batches, the joint pass rate will be significantly lower than individual indicators, suggesting separate talks with delivery and quality owners.
map.以某月 300 批交货为例: Example: 300 delivery batches in a month
map.准时 255 批、合格 270 批、准时且合格 240 批。准时率=255/30: On-time 255 batches, qualified 270 batches, on-time-and-qualified 240 batches. On-time rate = 255/300 = 85.00%, good-rate = 270/300 = 90.00%, joint pass rate = 240/300 = 80.00%, on-time-defective rate = (255−240)/300 = 5.00%, non-compliance rate = (300−240)/300 = 20.00%.
map.准时且合格为什么重要？: Why does on-time and qualified matter?
map.准时率和良品率单独看都可能偏高，但只有「既准时又合格」的批次才真正满足交付要求；: On-time rate and good-rate may both look high individually, but only batches that are 'both on-time and qualified' truly meet delivery requirements; joint pass rate = on-time-and-qualified ÷ total batches, the strictest measure of delivery quality.
map.四类计数怎么填？: How to fill the four count types?
map.总批次是分母；准时批次指按约定交期送达的批次数；合格批次指到货检验无次品的批次数: Total batches is the denominator; on-time batches are those delivered by the agreed date; qualified batches are those with no defects on arrival inspection; on-time-and-qualified must satisfy both (intersection) and cannot be simply added.
map.交货（准时率/次品率）统计。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安全。: Delivery (On-time/Defect Rate) Statistics. Free online tool, pure front-end processing, no data uploaded, protecting privacy and security.
map.准时率 = 准时批次 ÷ 总批次；良品率 = 良品批次 ÷ 总批次；联合合格率: On-time rate = on-time batches ÷ total batches; good-quality rate = good batches ÷ total batches; joint pass rate = on-time and good ÷ total batches; on-time but defective rate = (on-time − joint) ÷ total batches; not-simultaneously-compliant rate = (total − joint) ÷ total (the union of late or poor quality, not a single subset)
map.输入当月交货总批次、准时批次、合格批次与「准时且合格」批次（取交集），自动计算准: Enter the month's total delivery batches, on-time batches, qualified batches and "on-time and qualified" batches (the intersection); the tool computes the on-time rate, good-quality rate, joint pass rate, on-time-but-defective rate and not-simultaneously-compliant rate for supplier performance review.
map.准时 255 批、合格 270 批、准时且合格 240 批。准时率=255/30: On time 255, qualified 270, on-time and qualified 240 out of 300: on-time rate = 255/300 = 85.00%, good-quality rate = 270/300 = 90.00%, joint pass rate = 240/300 = 80.00%, on-time defective rate = (255−240)/300 = 5.00%, not-simultaneously-compliant rate = (300−240)/300 = 20.00% (the union of late or poor quality).
map.按交期与到货质量计算准时率与次品率，分供应商或时段汇总，用于供应链绩效评估，纯前: Compute on-time rate and defect rate from delivery dates and received quality, summarized by supplier or period for supply-chain performance review, entirely in the browser.
map.准时率 = 准时批次 ÷ 总批次；良品率 = 良品批次 ÷ 总批次；联合合格率: On-time rate = on-time lots ÷ total lots; good rate = good lots ÷ total; joint pass rate = on-time-and-good ÷ total; on-time-but-defective = (on-time − joint) ÷ total; not-simultaneously-compliant = (total − joint) ÷ total. Validation: all four are non-negative integers ≤ total; the intersection must satisfy max(0, on-time + good − total) ≤ joint ≤ min(on-time, good), otherwise calculation stops.
map.四项批次数均须为非负整数且单项 ≤ 总数；小数、负数、超标均拒绝。: All four lot counts must be non-negative integers ≤ total; decimals, negatives and over-total values are rejected.
map.准时且合格交集须满足 max(0, 准时+合格−总数) ≤ 交集 ≤ min(准: The on-time-and-good intersection must satisfy max(0, on-time + good − total) ≤ joint ≤ min(on-time, good); otherwise calculation stops.
map.不再输出负的「准时但不良率」；交集不成立时直接提示可行区间。: No negative “on-time but defective” rate is shown; an impossible intersection shows the feasible range instead.
